connector.name: Adu Zoning
connector.registryDescription: Check if a Florida address can build an ADU: county GIS zoning, eligibility verdict, local rules.
connector.summary: Hosted at adufloridainfo.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package adu-zoning-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the themutherfvcker account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
